```{r}

```

```{r}
TF_db <- read_csv('/project/imoskowitz/wiktor/5-Reference_tables/Mm_TF_DB_modified.csv')
```

```{r}
merged$is_tf <- ifelse(merged$gene_id %in% TF_db$Symbol, TRUE, FALSE)
```

```{r}
merged_tf <- filter(merged, is_tf)
```

```{r}
merged_tf %>%
  group_by(Significance, Quadrant) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>% View()
```

```{r}
unique(merged_tf$Significance)
```

```{r}
merged_tf$padj_tf_shf <-p.adjust(merged_tf$pvalue.SHF, method = 'BH')
merged_tf$padj_tf_jcf <-p.adjust(merged_tf$pvalue.JCF, method = 'BH')
```

```{r}
  merged_tf <- merged_tf %>%
    mutate(
      significance.SHF = ifelse(pvalue.SHF < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange.SHF) > 0.5, TRUE, FALSE),
      differentialExpression.SHF = case_when(pvalue.SHF < 0.05  & log2FoldChange.SHF > 0.5 ~ "up",
                                         pvalue.SHF< alpha & log2FoldChange.SHF < -0.5 ~ "down",
                                         TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
            significance.JCF = ifelse(pvalue.JCF < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange.JCF) > 0.5, TRUE, FALSE),
      differentialExpression.JCF = case_when(pvalue.JCF < 0.05  & log2FoldChange.JCF > 0.5 ~ "up",
                                         pvalue.JCF< alpha & log2FoldChange.JCF < -0.5 ~ "down",
                                         TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
```

```{r}
merged_tf <- merged_tf %>%
    mutate(
      Significance = case_when(
        significance.SHF == TRUE & significance.JCF == TRUE ~ "DEG in both",
        significance.SHF == TRUE & significance.JCF == FALSE ~"DEG in SHF",
        significance.SHF == FALSE & significance.JCF == TRUE ~"DEG in JCF",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      ),
      Quadrant = case_when(
        log2FoldChange.SHF > 0 & log2FoldChange.JCF >=0 ~ "upper-right",
        log2FoldChange.SHF <0 & log2FoldChange.JCF >=0 ~ "upper-left",
        log2FoldChange.SHF <0  & log2FoldChange.JCF <=0  ~ "lower-left",
        log2FoldChange.SHF >0 & log2FoldChange.JCF <=0  ~ "lower-right"
      )
    )

```

```{r}
plotCorrelations <- function(data, 
                             suffix = c(".x", ".y"),
                             title = NULL, 
                             color_column = "Significance", 
                             annotations_column = "annotations",
                             lfc_cutoff = 0,
                             point_colors = c("gray88",
                                              "darkseagreen",
                                              "plum2",
                                              "lightsalmon"),
                             show_labels = TRUE, 
                             show_deg_counts = TRUE,
                             point_size = 1, 
                             add_xy_lines = TRUE,
                             alpha= 0.8) {
  
  require(ggplot2)
  require(ggrepel)
  require(ggpmisc)
  require(dplyr)
  
  # Create summary data frame for annotations
  summary_data <- data %>%
    group_by(Significance, Quadrant) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    filter(Significance != "NS") # Filter out "Not significant in either"
  
  # Create coordinates for placing the text
  summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    mutate(x_coord = case_when(
      Quadrant == "upper-right" ~ max(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])]]) * 0.75,
      Quadrant == "upper-left" ~ min(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])]]) * 0.75,
      Quadrant == "lower-right" ~ max(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])]]) * 0.75,
      Quadrant == "lower-left" ~ min(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])]]) * 0.75,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    y_coord = case_when(
      Quadrant == "upper-right" ~ max(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]]) * 0.65, # Adjust y_coord lower
      Quadrant == "upper-left" ~ max(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]]) * 0.65,  # Adjust y_coord lower
      Quadrant == "lower-right" ~ min(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]]) * 0.65, # Adjust y_coord lower
      Quadrant == "lower-left" ~ min(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]]) * 0.65,  # Adjust y_coord lower
      TRUE ~ 0
    )) %>%
    mutate(offset = case_when(
      Significance == "Significant in both" ~ 1,
      Significance == paste0("Significant in ", gsub("\\.", "", suffix[1])) ~ 2,
      Significance == paste0("Significant in ", gsub("\\.", "", suffix[2])) ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )) %>%
    mutate(y_coord = y_coord + offset * 0.05 * diff(range(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]])))
  
  coords <- c(min(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])]]) + 1, max(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]]))
  correlation <- cor(data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])]], data[[paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])]], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Order the data for better plotting
  top_value <- "Significant in both"
  other_values <- sort(unique(data$Significance[data$Significance != top_value]))
  custom_order <- c(other_values, top_value)
  data$Signficance <- factor(data$Significance, levels = custom_order)
  data <- data %>% arrange(Significance)

  gg <- ggplot(data, aes(x = !!sym(paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[1])), y = !!sym(paste0("log2FoldChange", suffix[2])), col = !!sym(color_column), alpha = !!sym(color_column), size = !!sym(color_column))) +
    geom_point(size=point_size, alpha = alpha) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    scale_color_manual(values = point_colors) +
    theme_light(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
          legend.position = 'right', legend.direction = 'vertical', 
          axis.title = element_text(size=12),
          plot.title = element_text(size=13, face = "bold"),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
          legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), title = element_text(size=10)) +
    labs(title = title,
         x= paste0("LFC", suffix[1]),
         y= paste0("LFC", suffix[2]))
  
  if (add_xy_lines) {
    gg <- gg +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(lfc_cutoff, -lfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray61") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(lfc_cutoff, -lfc_cutoff), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'gray61')
  }
  
  if (show_labels) {
    gg <- gg +
      geom_label_repel(aes(label = !!sym(annotations_column)),
        box.padding = 0.25,
        point.padding = 0.5,
        force_pull = 20,
        size = 3,
        show.legend = FALSE,
        max.overlaps = Inf)
  }
  
  if (show_deg_counts) {
  gg <- gg +
    geom_text(data = summary_data, aes(x = x_coord, y = y_coord, label = count, color = Significance), size = 4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE)
}
  return(gg)
}
```
